history: No chocolate anywhere in it. The lemon and sugar together produce the flavor, which is the trick.
whyItWorks: Sugared citrus plus nut liqueur genuinely reads as chocolate cake — a well-known quirk of flavor perception.
steps: Shake the vodka and nut liqueur with ice and strain into a shot glass.
Coat a lemon wedge in sugar.
Take the shot, then bite the lemon immediately.
techniqueNotes: The lemon is not optional — without it the illusion does not happen.
name: Chocolate Cake Shot
description: Citrus vodka and hazelnut liqueur, chased by a sugared lemon.
